sentences.en: The pipe conveys water from the lake to the factory.
sentences.zh: 这条管道将湖水输送到工厂。

sentences.en: Kelly struck a match and put it to his pipe.
sentences.zh: 凯利划着一根火柴点燃了他的烟斗。

sentences.en: Grandfather talked to me with a pipe in his mouth.
sentences.zh: 祖父嘴里叼着烟斗跟我聊天。

senses.zh: 以管输送；装管道；吹奏；尖声说；(为衣服等)滚边
